messages:
Rita: quick follow-up from today's infra update: what happens if a region loses >30% GPUs in <2min? spill, degrade, or errors? cc @Cole

Cole (Infra): prefer absorb+short queue (<=250ms) then soft-spill to nearest-region if within latency SLO, then swap to quantized variant, last resort 503+Retry-After. drafting a short guidance doc.

Dana (SRE): from last canary: queue.p95 hitting ~420ms triggered spill; tail was noisy for ~0.4% of requests. log excerpt:

```
2026-03-26T11:02:01Z spot: reclaim 34%
2026-03-26T11:02:02Z queue.p95 422ms -> spill->eu-west1
```

Priya (Product): product teams want a per-project opt-out for cross-region spill and an estimated latency penalty shown in console.

AuditBot: Audit requirement noted: record origin_region, dest_region, timestamp, and sample request_ids on spill events.

Cole (Infra): action items: Cole to publish guidance by Friday, Dana add spill.telemetry + alert (spill.rate >0.5% 5m), Priya collect 2 prompt suites for quantized checks, OpsBot schedule a 30m follow-up.

Rita: thanks all, holding off on enabling cross-region by default until guidance + toggle land. :thumbsup:
